teaser: What happens when a number built for quiet illumination lands on a mind that cannot stop turning things over? You are a life path 11, called the Illuminator, carrying a charge most numbers do not carry, and an ENTP, built to question everything before it accepts anything. On a rooftop at dusk, someone asks what you believe, and you give them three answers before you give them one. The 11 wants to settle into a single bright thing and hand it to someone. The ENTP wants to turn it over one more time to see if it still holds. Both are curious about the same subject: what is actually true here. They rarely agree on when to stop asking.
excerpt: A fishing line goes slack, and you notice before your partner does, reeling it in with an alarm that has nothing to do with the fish.
